name: staged interchange-demand cadence
description: inspect how explicitly authored deterministic arrivals interact with one constrained stair and gate

factors.subject: passengers
factors.rationale: The 0.5 s, 1 s, and 2 s intervals expose deterministic demand-timing sensitivity without claiming an observed arrival process.

claim_boundary: This deterministic sensitivity study explores declared staged-demand schedules. It does not estimate an arrival distribution, passenger demand, station performance, operational suitability, or safety outcome.
